feature_name: Make react-dom optional peer dependency for React Native compatibility
description: Update the tRPC TanStack React Query package to mark react-dom as an optional peer dependency. This change will allow React Native and Expo developers to use tRPC without being forced to install react-dom, while maintaining the existing dependency relationship for web developers using React DOM.
functional_requirements: Update the package.json configuration to mark react-dom as an optional peer dependency
Ensure React remains a required peer dependency for all React environments
Maintain backward compatibility for web developers who use React DOM
Allow the package to install successfully in React Native/Expo environments with strict peer dependency resolution
